from profiles import display_name

def test_optional_nickname_contract():
    assert display_name({"name": "Ada"}) == "Ada"
    assert display_name({"name": "Ada", "nickname": "  "}) == "Ada"
    assert display_name({"name": "Ada", "nickname": "  Ace  "}) == "Ace"
